scope: 5000 unique authored wordings across 50 themes. Public question themes are paraphrased, not 5000 scraped user posts. The run measures offline target-source recall and evidence eligibility, not generated answer correctness, trained model weights, or online intent accuracy. Family holdout is reserved at authoring; viewing this report makes it unsuitable as a future blind test. Reddit is supplemental; X/Rednote were not scraped.
